description: Change the creator's name, bio, page address, kind of page (person or organisation), page language, dashboard language, and the links on the page. Only the fields you pass change. Links replace the whole list, so pass every link that should stay. The bio keeps bold, italic, links and line breaks and is cut at 280 characters. Changing the page address stops the old kulhad.co address working at once, with no redirect: printed QR codes, embeds and OBS overlay links break, and the old name is free for anyone to take. Not allowed while a custom domain is active. Writes to the creator's own Kulhad account only.

bio.description: A short introduction. Bold, italic, links and line breaks are kept, everything else is stripped, and it is cut at 280 characters.

name.description: The name shown on the page.

pageLanguage.description: The language the public page is written in.

socials.description: Replaces the whole list. Pass an empty array to remove every link.

username.description: The page address, as in kulhad.co/priya. The old address stops working immediately with no redirect, and the old name becomes free. Cannot be changed while a custom domain is active.

name: update_profile
title: Change my page details
